operating_notes.text: Novelis FY26 adjusted net debt was $6,724 mn against TTM adjusted EBITDA of $1,645 mn, a 4.1x net leverage ratio.
Bay Minette is a 600kt plant with ~$5 bn total cost, $3.2 bn spent through end-FY26, cold mill commissioning started March 2026.
FY26 FRP shipment mix: beverage packaging 62%, automotive 18%, specialties 17%, aerospace 3%.
CFIUS review of the AluChem acquisition was extended to July 2, 2026 after a partial US federal government shutdown tolled the statutory timelines.
FY26 Novelis shipments 3,557 KT vs 3,757 KT in FY25; adjusted EBITDA per tonne $462 vs $480.
Aluminium Upstream FY26 EBITDA per tonne $1,583 vs $1,449 in FY25; Q4 at a record $1,756.
Copper FY26 revenue ₹69,838 Cr vs ₹54,703 Cr in FY25, with segment EBITDA ₹2,809 Cr vs ₹3,025 Cr.
Novelis FY26 exit savings run rate reached $200 million with a target of $350-400 million by FY28.
Eternia operates through 170+ channel partners across 100+ cities; Bilaspur hub can produce up to 250,000 sq ft of windows a month.
India's windows and façade market estimated at ₹40,000 crore, largely unorganised, with premium segments growing at nearly 15% CAGR.

timeline.summary: Hindalco Industries Limited announced Novelis Inc.’s Q4 & FY 2025-26 earnings conference call on May 19, 2026, at 16:30 IST.
2026-05-19: Novelis reported FY26 net income down 98% to $15 mn on $925 mn Oswego fire losses, with net leverage at 4.1x and Bay Minette commissioning due 2H CY2026.
2026-05-20: Hindalco said CFIUS review of Aditya Holdings LLC's AluChem acquisition was extended to July 2, 2026 after a US federal government shutdown tolled the statutory timelines.
2026-05-22: Hindalco reported FY26 revenue up 15% to ₹2,74,944 Cr and record EBITDA of ₹38,097 Cr, but PAT fell to ₹13,391 Cr on the Oswego fire disruption; net debt/EBITDA rose to 1.83x.
Hindalco Industries Limited’s Geetika Anand shared Q4 and FY2025-26 earnings call recording on May 22, 2026, via the company website.

On May 26, 2026, Hindalco filed the Q4 and FY2026 earnings call transcript, reporting an 11% YoY rise in consolidated segment EBITDA to ₹10,812 Cr alongside strong progress in India expansion and Novelis cost savings.

2026-06-04: Hindalco launched Eternia's flagship aluminium window experience centre in Lajpat Nagar, New Delhi, and flagged a Bilaspur (Gurugram) hub, targeting over ₹1,000 Cr Eternia revenue by FY29.
Birla Group Holdings Private Limited, as Hindalco Industries Limited’s promoter, declared no new encumbrances for FY2026 on 08|0y|2026.
NSE Sustainability Ratings & Analytics assigned an independent ESG rating of 68 to Hindalco Industries.
Earnings Conference Call of Novelis Inc., wholly owned subsidiary of Hindalco Industries Limited, scheduled for Thursday, 5 November 2026 at 17:30 HRS IST.
Hindalco Industries Limited will hold Q2 FY27 Earnings Conference Call on Friday, November 6, 2026, at 16:30 HRS IST.
